toolArgs.label: Normalize Invoices
toolArgs.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT
    i.*,
    f.Date AS FX_Date,
    CASE i.Currency
      WHEN 'USD' THEN 1.0
      WHEN 'EUR' THEN f.USD_EUR
      WHEN 'GBP' THEN f.USD_GBP
      WHEN 'JPY' THEN f.USD_JPY
      WHEN 'NOK' THEN f.USD_NOK
      WHEN 'CHF' THEN f.USD_CHF
      WHEN 'SEK' THEN f.USD_SEK
    END AS Rate,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY i.InvoiceID
      ORDER BY ABS(DATEDIFF('day', i.Date, f.Date)), f.Date
    ) AS rn
  FROM invoice_raw i
  CROSS JOIN fx_rates f
)
SELECT
  InvoiceID, Date, Vendor, Country, Description, Quantity, UoM, UnitPrice, Currency, TotalAmount,
  CASE UoM
    WHEN 'lb' THEN ROUND(Quantity * 0.45359237, 6)
    WHEN 'gallon' THEN ROUND(Quantity * 3.78541, 6)
    WHEN 'short_ton' THEN ROUND(Quantity * 0.907185, 6)
    ELSE ROUND(Quantity, 6)
  END AS Qty_Normalized,
  CASE UoM
    WHEN 'lb' THEN 'kg'
    WHEN 'gallon' THEN 'liter'
    WHEN 'short_ton' THEN 'metric_ton'
    ELSE UoM
  END AS UoM_Normalized,
  Rate,
  ROUND(UnitPrice / Rate, 6) AS UnitPrice_USD,
  ROUND(TotalAmount / Rate, 2) AS TotalAmount_USD
FROM matched
WHERE rn = 1

toolArgs.label: Normalize Invoices
toolArgs.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE invoice_normalized AS
SELECT
  i.*,
  CASE i.UoM
    WHEN 'kg' THEN ROUND(i.Quantity, 6)
    WHEN 'liter' THEN ROUND(i.Quantity, 6)
    WHEN 'metric_ton' THEN ROUND(i.Quantity, 6)
    WHEN 'lb' THEN ROUND(i.Quantity * 0.45359237, 6)
    WHEN 'gallon' THEN ROUND(i.Quantity * 3.78541, 6)
    WHEN 'short_ton' THEN ROUND(i.Quantity * 0.907185, 6)
    ELSE ROUND(i.Quantity, 6)
  END AS Qty_Normalized,
  CASE i.UoM
    WHEN 'lb' THEN 'kg'
    WHEN 'gallon' THEN 'liter'
    WHEN 'short_ton' THEN 'metric_ton'
    ELSE i.UoM
  END AS UoM_Normalized,
  CASE i.Currency
    WHEN 'USD' THEN 1.0
    WHEN 'EUR' THEN fx.USD_EUR
    WHEN 'GBP' THEN fx.USD_GBP
    WHEN 'JPY' THEN fx.USD_JPY
    WHEN 'NOK' THEN fx.USD_NOK
    WHEN 'CHF' THEN fx.USD_CHF
    WHEN 'SEK' THEN fx.USD_SEK
  END AS Rate,
  ROUND(i.UnitPrice / CASE i.Currency
    WHEN 'USD' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'EUR' THEN fx.USD_EUR WHEN 'GBP' THEN fx.USD_GBP
    WHEN 'JPY' THEN fx.USD_JPY WHEN 'NOK' THEN fx.USD_NOK WHEN 'CHF' THEN fx.USD_CHF WHEN 'SEK' THEN fx.USD_SEK END, 6) AS UnitPrice_USD,
  ROUND(i.TotalAmount / CASE i.Currency
    WHEN 'USD' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'EUR' THEN fx.USD_EUR WHEN 'GBP' THEN fx.USD_GBP
    WHEN 'JPY' THEN fx.USD_JPY WHEN 'NOK' THEN fx.USD_NOK WHEN 'CHF' THEN fx.USD_CHF WHEN 'SEK' THEN fx.USD_SEK END, 2) AS TotalAmount_USD
FROM invoice_raw i
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT * FROM fx_rates f
  ORDER BY ABS(date_diff('day', i.Date, f.Date))
  LIMIT 1
) fx ON TRUE

config.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT
    i.*,
    f.Date AS FX_Date,
    CASE i.Currency
      WHEN 'USD' THEN 1.0
      WHEN 'EUR' THEN f.USD_EUR
      WHEN 'GBP' THEN f.USD_GBP
      WHEN 'JPY' THEN f.USD_JPY
      WHEN 'NOK' THEN f.USD_NOK
      WHEN 'CHF' THEN f.USD_CHF
      WHEN 'SEK' THEN f.USD_SEK
    END AS Rate,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY i.InvoiceID
      ORDER BY ABS(DATEDIFF('day', i.Date, f.Date)), f.Date
    ) AS rn
  FROM invoice_raw i
  CROSS JOIN fx_rates f
)
SELECT
  InvoiceID, Date, Vendor, Country, Description, Quantity, UoM, UnitPrice, Currency, TotalAmount,
  CASE UoM
    WHEN 'lb' THEN ROUND(Quantity * 0.45359237, 6)
    WHEN 'gallon' THEN ROUND(Quantity * 3.78541, 6)
    WHEN 'short_ton' THEN ROUND(Quantity * 0.907185, 6)
    ELSE ROUND(Quantity, 6)
  END AS Qty_Normalized,
  CASE UoM
    WHEN 'lb' THEN 'kg'
    WHEN 'gallon' THEN 'liter'
    WHEN 'short_ton' THEN 'metric_ton'
    ELSE UoM
  END AS UoM_Normalized,
  Rate,
  ROUND(UnitPrice / Rate, 6) AS UnitPrice_USD,
  ROUND(TotalAmount / Rate, 2) AS TotalAmount_USD
FROM matched
WHERE rn = 1

SELECT
  Date,
  ROUND(SUM(TotalAmount_USD), 2) AS Total_Spend_USD,
  COUNT(*) AS Invoice_Count
FROM normalized_invoices
GROUP BY Date
ORDER BY Date
